text.en:
The articles specifically listed in Annex "A" hereof, as classified
under Section 104 of the Tariff and Customs Code of 1978, as amended, shall be subject
to the rates of imbort duty in accordance with the schedule indicated opposite each

The Nomenclature and the rates of import duty on tariff headings not
enumerated and those listed but represented by the symbol "XXX" shall remain in force

Upon the effectivity of this Executive Order, the articles specifically
listed in the aforesaid Annex "A" which are entered or withdrawn from warehouses in the
Philippines for consumption shall be levied the rates of duty herein prescribed.

All other Presidential issuances, administrative rules and regulations, or
parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby revoked or
modified accordingly.
POMA Outgeing , 10359

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately following, its
complete publication in two (2) newspapers of general circulation in the Philippines.
Done in the City of Manila, this
9th day of April
Our Lord, two thousand and two.
in the year of
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
